issue.title: test_loading_then_loaded in the bead preview modal timed out once in a scoped check, passes on rerun

task_type_fields.evidence:
Reported by sase-1t2.12 (ops_polish phase of epic sase-1t2, note #3, 2026-11-16): the test timed out once during that phase's `sase tool run check` and passed on rerun on the same tree. The phase did not touch the bead preview modal.

Re-observed by the sase-1t2 land agent on 2026-11-17: passes serially (`pytest -n 0 tests/ace/tui/modals/test_bead_preview_modal.py::test_loading_then_loaded`, 1/1). Observed fail rate: 1 failure in the reported lanes; no serial reproduction. Likely a load-sensitive wait (loading -> loaded transition) under the parallel scoped lane, but the root cause is unconfirmed.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1t2 epic lander triaged a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from phase sase-1t2.12 reporting a one-off timeout of this test; no existing task tracked it, so it is recorded for corroboration.
